why: The per-callee fact "writes none of its arguments" (callee-facts.mjs, exec/callee-trace.mjs, design/w8e-callee-facts.md). The parent of tags reads rec.tags.length before `isPlainObject(rec)` (shape.ts, a guard that writes nothing), the candidate after it, and both push to rec.tags after the call: without the fact the reading refuses both (read-after-call: the call may change rec). Lane B records every call of isPlainObject writing nothing and answering no object of rec on both sides, so the fact holds and lane A proves tags under it, the fact named in lanes.A.assumptions with lane B's count. tagsWriter makes the same move across `isTagged(rec)` (writer.ts, which clears the tags): WITNESS. sameWriter makes no move across isTagged: lane B records it writing, the fact does not hold, lane A stays refused (read-after-call), PASS-bounded. tests/callee-fact.mjs checks the certificates; LEAN_BREAK=callee-fact and LEAN_BREAK=callee-fact-trace prove sameWriter under a premise lane B saw broken. kept moves the read across remember(rec) (keep.ts, which keeps rec) and a later isSmall(...): the fact also covers what the run handed the recorded calls before (lane B reads those too), so both are facts and lane A proves kept naming both. keptWriter makes the same move across touchKept, which clears the tags remember kept: WITNESS. sameKeptWriter makes no move across touchKept: lane B records it writing what remember kept, no fact, lane A refused; LEAN_BREAK=callee-fact-prior (lane B reads only the call's own arguments) proves it under touchKept's fact.
